messages:
alex_csm: Heads-up — HarborTech renewal risk. Usage dropped ~42% MoM for the last 4 weeks and procurement says they're running a competitive POC. No onboarding blockers in our notes. Can we triage and get a plan? Need a customer touch by EOD Fri. cc @maria_cs @sara_successops

maria_cs: Got it. pulling usage details now. can you confirm org id? last I had was HT-3472.

alex_csm: Yes HT-3472. Main routes are /generate and /embed — drop is concentrated on /generate.

ryan_se: I'll check routing, quotas, and any 4xx/5xx patterns. Quick Q: did they switch model variants recently (cheaper model)?

matt_eng: looked at recent deploys — no model swaps. saw a bump in 5xxs on our edge for that org around 3/10-3/14. snippet: ```org=HT-3472 error_rate: 5xx 0.8% -> 3.4% (3/10-3/14) p50_latency +120ms```

sara_successops: I'll set up a customer touchpoint — proposing Wed 10am PT. Want Ryan + Maria on the call. I'll draft agenda: status, usage decline, cost vs perf, and the competitive POC ask.

alex_csm: Agenda works. Also want to surface recent SLOs and quick cost-lowering levers (batching, quantization) as talking points. @matt_eng can you prepare 2-3 options with expected token-cost delta?

matt_eng: Yep. Quick options: 1) enable per-customer small-batch for /generate (est 10-15% cost down), 2) suggest Llama-2-70B-quant for non-critical paths (est ~30% cost), 3) prefix caching for repeated prompts. I'll attach numbers before the call.

ops-bot: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/HT-3472/health — includes last 30d usage graph, invoices, and eval notes.

maria_cs: :eyes: noted their adoption cohort — two power users reduced activity last month. I'll reach out to internal champions to understand churn drivers.

alex_csm: Action items: Ryan - infra logs + 5xx root cause; Matt - concrete cost options + estimates; Maria - champion outreach + user pulse; Sara - schedule + agenda; I'll prep renewal playbook + competitive talking points. We'll own the follow-up and align before call.

maria_cs: One more ask — procurement asked if we support on-prem inference for sensitive workloads. Should we prepare a short brief on Dedicated/Private options?

alex_csm: Yes, prepare a short brief comparing Dedicated vs Private + SLA and deployment tradeoffs. Keep it 1 page.

sara_successops: Putting invites now. tagging the group — please add any blockers or notes in-thread. Thanks :thumbsup:
